meta.model: run_pad_bekker_p0.Model (5.31.2) + in-plane gravity moment (effective COG), floor axes
meta.frames: floor axes = body axes of a body lying flat on the floor; x fwd, y left, z along the floor normal. q_floor = [uz m, phi rad, theta rad], point displacement uz + y phi - x theta; roll > 0 left up, pitch > 0 nose down. Floor R_f = Ry(pitch) Rx(roll) (harness Plant convention, floor z = -tan(pitch) x + tan(roll) y). Absolute attitude = ZYX of R_f R_settle (gravity-referenced, IMU).
meta.pad_variant: B (pads not in contact in the settle, A and B give the same rows)
assumptions: crawler shear in the contact plane carries W sin(alpha), no moment arm (SCM shear has no sinkage coupling)
shear capacity c A + N tan(phi) per track (recorded only)
small settle angles in floor axes
rigid = P0 concrete Winkler crawler (same model, for the delta)
meta.hook_note: hook[soil|level|roll|pitch]: harness correction soil - rigid in the SAME model (as the flat SoilPads: dtheta = soil - rigid, h = (uz_rig - uz_soil) + x tan dtheta). Extension: floor roll += d_roll_deg, floor pitch += d_pitch_deg, SoilPads.h = pad_h_m (= -d_uz + x tan d_pitch - y tan d_roll), pads FL FR RL RR.
meta.key_format: '{soil}|{level}|{roll:g}|{pitch:g}' with the floor roll / pitch in deg, e.g. 'J1|top|2.7355|1.7592'
meta.hook_harness_note: RECOMMENDED hook. Calibrated on the harness's own rigid crawler (layout D), not on the P0 Winkler rigid: make_plant(..., slope=(roll + floor_roll_add_deg, pitch + floor_pitch_add_deg)) WITHOUT the flat P0 pitch add of make_plant (floor_pitch_add_deg already contains it), then SoilPads.h = pad_h_m (goff = -h). Check: harness settle attitude in the original-floor axes = target_q_floor (residual_*), pad bottom to original soil surface = P0 soil settle gap (gap_target_mm). Means over 5.0 s after the harness settle (rocking left by the start pose).
